products.text:
Type: blackout grommet curtain panels, set of two
Use: darkening a room, privacy at windows; bedroom, living room, home office
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: thick woven polyester blackout fabric, dark metal grommets
Colors: charcoal black, dark grey
Shape: straight plain panels with soft vertical folds, grommet top on a rod, short window length, solid and opaque
Feel: cozy, calm, enclosing
Goes with: white or beige walls, warm leather, wood tones, black hardware; modern or minimalist bedrooms and living rooms

Type: hairpin leg writing desk
Use: working, studying at a desk; home office, bedroom, living room
Style: mid-century modern, industrial, modern
Materials: walnut wood veneer, black metal hairpin legs
Colors: warm medium walnut brown, black
Shape: rectangular top with raised back shelf and three cubbies, curved side rails, single slim center drawer, four thin hairpin legs, light and open
Feel: warm, tidy, retro, airy
Goes with: white walls, black accents, leather chairs, brass; mid-century or modern home offices

Type: arched bronze table lamp
Use: reading and ambient light on a desk, side table or nightstand; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, traditional
Materials: bronze-finished metal, white fabric drum shade
Colors: dark bronze, white
Shape: wide white drum shade hung from a curved sweeping arm, round weighted disc base, asymmetric and sculptural, medium size
Feel: elegant, soft, refined
Goes with: dark wood, cream or grey walls, bronze and black metals; contemporary or classic living rooms and bedrooms

Type: hexagonal wall planter
Use: holding small plants or succulents on a wall; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: modern, minimalist, industrial
Materials: matte earthenware, concrete-like finish
Colors: cool medium grey, darker grey interior
Shape: flat hexagon with open pocket front, keyhole hanger on back, shallow and compact, geometric
Feel: clean, earthy, understated
Goes with: green plants, white walls, light wood, black accents; modern, Scandinavian or industrial rooms

Type: wall clock with mail organizer
Use: telling time, storing mail and papers on a wall; entryway, home office, living room
Style: farmhouse, rustic, industrial
Materials: knotty natural pine wood, black metal clock frame and hands
Colors: warm light natural wood, black
Shape: tall narrow rectangular panel, square open-frame clock with Roman numerals on top, stacked slanted slat pockets below, flat
Feel: homey, practical, rustic
Goes with: white or cream walls, black hardware, distressed wood; farmhouse or rustic rooms

Type: framed abstract geode print
Use: decorating a wall above a desk, sofa or bed; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, coastal, modern
Materials: printed canvas, thin silver metal frame
Colors: navy blue, light sky blue, pale aqua, white, silver
Shape: square, layered watercolor rings forming a geode, slim frame, small size
Feel: calm, cool, fresh
Goes with: white or grey walls, blue textiles, chrome or silver accents; coastal or contemporary rooms
